description: This file implements OAuth authentication flow for MiniMax, including generating PKCE challenges, requesting authorization codes, polling for tokens, and a high-level login function that manages user interaction and token retrieval.

methods.name: getOAuthEndpoints
methods.description: Constructs OAuth endpoint URLs based on the specified region.

methods.name: generatePkce
methods.description: Generates a PKCE verifier, challenge, and state for OAuth security.

methods.name: requestOAuthCode
methods.description: Requests an OAuth authorization code from the server using challenge and state.

methods.name: pollOAuthToken
methods.description: Polls the OAuth token endpoint to retrieve an access token after user authorization.

methods.name: loginMiniMaxPortalOAuth
methods.description: Main function to initiate OAuth login flow, open URL, notify user, and poll for token.
